title: Rebuilding Lahaina Small Boat Harbor
summary: The committee deferred the Lahaina Harbor update on August 22 with no objections. The harbor office may begin to rebuild in September, according to reports, and the fuel dock reopened earlier this month. Rebuilding is estimated to cost $30 million.

timeline.text: The committee deferred the harbor update with no objections.

timeline.text: The chair said it has been reported that the harbor office may begin to rebuild in September.

timeline.text: The fuel dock at Lahaina Harbor reopened earlier this month, the chair said.

timeline.text: The chair said many boat owners lost not just a boat but a source of income and livelihood.
